rule: Every non-infra FAIL is a learning opportunity. Before any retry: (1) write a Labradorite (or structured) critique with root_cause + evidence + smallest_experiment, (2) record the lesson if a new pattern appears, (3) enqueue only the new job id from the critique. Never re-run the same failed file still sitting in failed/. Never chain playbooks. Convert the failure into durable apprentice knowledge so the same class of error is less likely next time.
